title: Studio verdict (batches/<id>/verdict.json)
description: Written by the page when the user presses Submit. Never written for them.

note.description: The user's note on the whole batch, exact.

answer.description: For a question: the user's answer in their own words.

marks.description: Parts of the picture or model the user painted, in up to five colours, each with a note; or, on a sound or a clip, moments and stretches of time, each with its own note (spans). The page also keeps a picture of them at marks/<candidate>.png.

notes.description: colour -> the user's note for that colour, exact

where.description: colour -> where those marks sit, worked out by the page

strokes.description: On a picture: {c: colour or erase, r: radius in the picture's pixels, p: [[x, y], ...]}. On a model: {c: colour or erase, r: the brush's radius in the mesh's own units, m: mesh number (the paint is on it and on the other primitives of the same mesh), p: [x, y, z, nx, ny, nz, ...] six numbers a point, in the mesh's own unposed space with the way to the eye from it when it was painted, each point joined to the one before, j: 1 when it is more of the drag before it}. Later strokes cover earlier ones; erase hides what is under it.

size.description: On a picture: its width and height in pixels

faces.description: On a model marked by whole faces (before there were strokes, or in a browser without WebGL2): mesh number -> colour -> face numbers

meshes.description: On a model: mesh number -> its name

moments.description: On a moving model: colour -> {clip, t, length}, the motion and the second it was painted at

file.description: On a sound or a clip: the name of the candidate's file the marks are on

length.description: On a sound or a clip: its length in seconds

fps.description: On a clip: frames a second; missing when it could not be told

tempo.description: On a sound filed with a tempo: beats a minute, beats to the bar, and the second the first bar starts at. Given by the maker, never worked out.

spans.description: On a sound or a clip (kind sound or video): the marks, in time order. Here the note belongs to the mark, not to a colour, and notes and where keyed by colour are not used. On a clip, size is the frame's width and height. A mark's own picture, when it has one, is at marks/<candidate>/<id>.png.

tag.description: What the mark asks for. keep: this part must come through a redo as it is. cut: this stretch goes.

t1.description: Where it ends; the same as t0 for a moment

note.description: The user's note on this mark, exact

where.description: A sentence the page writes: the times, the bar and beat, what it measured there

facts.description: On a sound: numbers the page measured in the stretch (peak and RMS in dBFS, the share of energy in five bands, and the same for the whole sound)

strokes.description: On a clip: paint on the frame at t0, as on a picture, in the pixels of size

box.description: On a clip: a part of the picture the user points at, on screen for the whole of the mark (at t0 only for a moment). Shares of the frame from its top left corner, kept inside it. With a box on a stretch, its middle and last frames have pictures too, at marks/<candidate>/<id>-middle.png and <id>-end.png.
